notes: Count 60300. Greenland holds 58% of its present ice, 4.3 m of sea level.

event: Ice saddle fails; north and south domes part
Lower canyon uncovered; a summer river runs to Petermann Fjord
The watching fork foresees the interior collapse
notes: From the shape of the bed. It says nothing.

event: Interior collapse: 2 m of sea level leaves as icebergs
notes: About 0.1 Sv of fresh water. Analogue: Heinrich events.
North Atlantic shores 2-3 C cooler. Baltic harvests fail. Registry lost. Count falls to 88000.

event: Interior Greenland is a shallow sea, then lakes
Count reaches 19000; 1900 skills held by nobody
The staying fork offers to teach
notes: Councils argue nine years and accept. 412 skills over 300 years.

event: Last of the ice sheet breaks into valley glaciers
Snow begins to last through summer on the eastern plateau
notes: Land has risen 500 m. CO2 falling.

event: Forks return. Count 74000. New ice cap of 9000 km2
